outcome: Prevalence of lower urinary tract symptoms (LUTS)
finding: LUTS were more prevalent during pregnancy than after childbirth, with nocturia and frequency being the most common, and cesarean section was associated with a decreased prevalence of both storage and voiding LUTS after delivery.
mod_finding: Compared to vaginal delivery, cesarean section was a protective factor against both voiding LUTS and storage LUTS.
